backend/main.mo: Defines the backend canister with user data types, task/timetable/note/reminder structures, and persistent maps for storing all user-specific records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two features, their component dependencies, related files, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON mapping of frontend file paths to short functional summaries for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: App entry HTML specifying meta tags and linking v3 generated Scholar Gold favicon and app icon assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, profile setup, navigation tabs, and loading states with query client setup.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: UI for purchasing and selecting background themes with rarity tiers, coin checks, uploads, and camera capture support.
frontend/src/components/DailyGoalProgres: Displays and edits the user's daily study goal while showing today's progress based on completed study sessions.
frontend/src/components/DailySyllabusRem: Checks daily syllabus completion and triggers a browser notification after 8 PM if none are completed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with branding and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Provides the main app header with theme switching, authentication controls, and user avatar menu.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Shows a marketing-style login page with feature highlights and an Internet Identity login button.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyStudySumm: Shows monthly study stats including total minutes and best 7-day window, with month navigation.
frontend/src/components/NoteLinker.tsx: Allows linking, unlinking, or creating notes to associate with another item using dialogs and note queries.
frontend/src/components/NotesSection.tsx: UI for creating, editing, and deleting notes with text, images, and voice recordings, using various mutations and media handling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSection.t: User profile view and editor supporting bio updates, image upload/removal, name changes, and level/coin-related info.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Initial profile creation dialog that collects name and bio and triggers the profile initialization mutation.
frontend/src/components/ReminderNotifica: Schedules and displays browser notifications for upcoming reminders, persisting notified IDs in session storage.
frontend/src/components/RemindersSection: CRUD interface for reminders including date/time selection, note linking, and edit/delete dialogs.
frontend/src/components/RewardShopSectio: Coin-based virtual shop allowing purchase of avatar frames, badges, and themes, with simple local ownership tracking.
frontend/src/components/StopwatchSection: Implements a persistent stopwatch with start, pause, resume, and reset functionality synced to a backend actor and restored on load. Manages elapsed time updates via intervals and displays UI controls.
frontend/src/components/StudyHeatmapView: Generates a 90‑day study heatmap using weekly session data and visualizes intensity levels per day. Provides tooltips and dynamic color-coding based on minutes studied.
frontend/src/components/SyllabusTrackerS: Manages a syllabus tracker with subjects, subtopics, exam countdown, local storage persistence, and CRUD dialogs. Tracks progress and integrates a task completion heatmap.
frontend/src/components/TaskCompletionHe: Builds a 90‑day heatmap of completed tasks by grouping them per day and week with intensity-based coloring. Includes month labels and tooltip details for each date.
frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx: Provides a pomodoro and custom timer with session recording, streak and coin integration, notifications, and phase transitions. Manages countdown logic, UI controls, and backend updates.
frontend/src/components/timetable/DoneTo: Checkbox component for toggling whether a timetable entry is completed today using tick history.
frontend/src/components/timetable/EditTi: Dialog for editing a timetable entry's title and activity type while showing read‑only schedule info.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Dialog showing last six months of daily completion history for a timetable entry with statistics.
frontend/src/components/TimetableSection: Main timetable UI for listing, creating, editing, and deleting timetable entries, including time validation and dialogs.
frontend/src/components/TodoSection.tsx: Task management interface allowing creation, editing, completion toggling, deletion, and linking notes.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyStudyTimeG: Displays a weekly bar chart of study session durations aggregated by type with summary stats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor based on identity, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailySyllabusCheck: Tracks a daily syllabus checkoff count by polling localStorage every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication with login, logout, and status handling.
Custom hook that syncs state to localStorage with safe JSON parsing and optional numeric clamping.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for interacting with backend actor methods for profiles, coins, and other user data.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/NotificationManager.ts: Utility class for showing toast and browser notifications with type‑based styling and permission handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrorMessage.t: Maps backend error strings to user‑friendly messages with fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/levelRanks.ts: Defines level rank constants and normalizes legacy rank values.
frontend/src/utils/timetableDates.ts: Helpers for converting timestamps to date keys and checking if a timestamp is today.
frontend/src/utils/timetableHistory.ts: Generates date ranges and maps timetable ticks to daily completion status for the last six months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from URL or storage.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyStudyGraph.ts: Aggregates the last seven days of completed study sessions into daily totals by session type.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, container settings, plugins, and animations.
project_state.json: Captures the project’s current feature scope, architectural notes, known issues, and image requirements for ongoing development.
